title: Pay with a glance? Qwen's new AI glasses and earphones make a grand debut, ushering in a new era of proactive AI

content_html:
On October 13, Qwen officially launched three new AI products: the AI glasses N1 and N1Pro, and an AI ear clip headset co-developed with Bose, marking the deep extension of AI personal agents (Personal Agents) into the physical world.

The N1 series is equipped with a 50-megapixel imaging system, a 1G5P lens, and a self-developed edge-side visual understanding model, supporting environmental perception, translation, meeting notes, and voice-based tasks at any time. Among them, the N1Pro is the first AI glasses in the industry to support real-time vital sign monitoring (heart rate, blood oxygen, skin temperature), and innovatively introduces eye movement interaction and iris authentication payment technology with an error rate of less than one in a million. The co-branded AI ear clip headset features an open design, supporting real-time translation in 89 languages, AI note-taking, and complex task delegation.

The new products were available for purchase on the same day. With the national subsidy and limited-time offers, the glasses start at 2218 yuan, and the earphones start at 1099 yuan. This launch demonstrates the industry trend of AI hardware moving from single assistance to "active service," further accelerating the commercial deployment of large models at the edge in real-world scenarios.
